manual.title: Add ASIC Miner
manual.description: Enter the IP address of your ASIC miner.

scan.title: Scan Network
scan.description: Enter the subnet to scan. This has been pre-filled from your network settings.

scanning.title: Scanning…
scanning.description: Scanning {subnet} for ASIC miners. This may take up to 30 seconds.

pick_miner.title: Select Miner
pick_miner.description: Choose a miner from the list of devices found on your network.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Enter login credentials for {host}, or leave blank if authentication is not required.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address and that the miner is online.
error.no_miners_found: No miners were found on that subnet. Try a different range.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: Miner Options
init.description: Tick which sensor categories to create. Unticking a category removes its entities on the next reload. Changing any option reloads the integration.

data.timezone_check: Keep miner timezone in sync (incl. DST)

data_description.sensor_categories: Tick the groups to create. Unticked groups are removed on reload.
data_description.only_available: Skip sensors that don't apply to this miner (e.g. fluid/water temperatures on air-cooled miners, chip temperature where the firmware doesn't report it).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the miner. Lower = fresher data but more load on the miner (default 30 s).
data_description.power_entity: If set, polling pauses while this switch/sensor is off, then runs a fast boot loop after power-on. Leave empty to always poll.
data_description.boot_timeout: How long to wait for the miner to come up after power-on before raising the boot-timeout alarm (default 120 s).
data_description.simple_naming: Generate deterministic entity_ids “miner_<name>_<key>” from the entry name for NEW entities. Existing entities are migrated only via the “Apply naming scheme” button.
data_description.timezone_check: When set, the miner's timezone is checked periodically and at startup against Home Assistant's own zone. VNish miners have no DST, so the correct offset is re-applied at each DST change.
data_description.timezone_mode: “auto” corrects a mismatch automatically; “repair” only raises a repairable issue for you to confirm.
data_description.power_sensor: External power reading (watt sensor preferred, or a switch/binary_sensor) that tells the status sensor whether the miner draws power — separates “off” from an unreachable-but-powered miner. Falls back to the polling power entity when empty.
data_description.power_switch: The controllable outlet the power_on / power_off services operate.
data_description.boot_grace_seconds: After power-on, how long an unreachable miner is still “starting” before it becomes “fault” (default 120 s).
data_description.shutdown_delay_seconds: In power_off, the pause→power-off delay (default 30 s).
data_description.mining_power_threshold_w: Optional external watt level at/above which the miner counts as “mining” even without live hashrate.
data_description.warmup_hashrate_fraction: Hashrate/expected ratio below which a hashing miner reads “warming_up” instead of “mining” (default 0.8).

power_on.name: Power on miner
power_on.description: Switches the configured power_switch on. The status then progresses from “starting” to “mining” on its own once the miner is reachable and hashing. No-op if the outlet is already on.

power_off.name: Power off miner
power_off.description: First pauses mining via firmware, sets the status to “stopping”, waits shutdown_delay_seconds, then switches the power_switch off.

options.miner_summary: Miner summary (hashrate, power, J/TH, temps, uptime, pools)
options.board_temps: Per-board temperatures (PCB board + inlet/outlet chip temps)

confirm.title: Fix miner timezone
confirm.description: The timezone on {name} is “{current}” but should be “{target}” (from Home Assistant's configured zone). Confirm to set the correct timezone on the miner.
